tagline: A world leader in specialty coatings, sealants, building materials and related services for construction, industrial, and consumer markets
hero_kpi_rationale: The Construction Products Group (CPG) segment represents 38% of total sales, the company's largest segment, and is the primary growth driver in the residential and commercial construction and renovation market.

kpis.name: Construction Products Group segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of construction products such as sealants, coatings, waterproofing systems and roofing.
kpis.description: CPG is RPM's largest segment, including brands such as Tremco and illbruck, active in residential and commercial markets.
kpis.signal: Primary segment with 38% of total sales.

kpis.name: Total net sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue after deduction of returns and allowances for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2025.
kpis.description: Consolidated sales for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2025, generated 30% internationally.
kpis.signal: Consolidated sales of $7.4 billion for fiscal year 2025, generated 30% internationally.

kpis.name: International sales percentage
kpis.explanation: Percentage of sales realized outside the United States.
kpis.description: RPM sells its products in approximately 163 countries, with 30% of sales realized outside the United States.

kpis.name: Consumer Group segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from products sold to consumers via the Rust-Oleum brand and others.
kpis.description: Includes consumer brands such as Rust-Oleum, Zinsser and DAP, targeted at DIY enthusiasts and building professionals.
kpis.signal: Second largest segment by size with 33% of sales.

kpis.name: Performance Coatings Group segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from high-performance coatings for industrial and infrastructure applications.
kpis.description: Includes anticorrosion products, industrial floor coatings, high-performance flooring systems and fall protection solutions.
kpis.signal: Specialized in industrial and infrastructure repair markets with 20% of sales.

kpis.name: Specialty Products Group segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from specialized products such as colorants, nail polish and edible coatings.
kpis.description: Active in specialized markets such as equipment restoration, cosmetics, factory-applied industrial coatings and edible coatings for pharmaceutical and food industries.
kpis.signal: Specialized segment with 9% of sales in high-margin niches.

kpis.name: Global production facilities
kpis.explanation: Number of plants operated by RPM subsidiaries worldwide.
kpis.description: Facilities located in North America, Europe, Asia, Latin America and South Africa, covering countries such as Canada, Mexico, Brazil, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, United Kingdom, Netherlands, Belgium, Poland, India, Malaysia, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand, Chile, Colombia, Argentina and United Arab Emirates.

kpis.name: Share repurchase authorization
kpis.explanation: Amount remaining available to repurchase shares under the authorized program.
kpis.description: $192.3 million remaining authorized under the repurchase program as of May 31, 2025, demonstrating an ongoing commitment to capital returns.

risks.title: Dependence on construction market conditions
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned first in the 10-K, with strong language on sensitivity to economic cycles. The high CPG share (38% of sales) amplifies the exposure. Macro category weighted heavily.

risks.title: Intense competition across all segments
risks.score_rationale: Multiple paragraphs describe increased competition, particularly from large conglomerates and low-cost manufacturers. Repeated and emphatic language on pricing pressure and market share.

risks.title: Global supply chain risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk is detailed with concrete examples of potential disruptions (geopolitical, logistics, shortages). High position in the document and intensity of language. Industrial category heavily impacted.

risks.title: Exposure to raw material price fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Frequent mention in the 10-K, with direct link to gross margin. Impact is significant as chemicals represent a large portion of costs. Concerned but measured language.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and potential attacks
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated item (Item 1C) underscores risk importance. Clear language on operational and financial consequences. Cybersecurity category rising in importance.

risks.title: Acquisition integration
risks.score_rationale: RPM regularly mentions its acquisition strategy. Integration risk is moderate but recurring, with cautious language on synergies and post-merger management.

risks.title: Strict environmental regulation
risks.score_rationale: Multiple paragraphs detail regulatory requirements in the United States and internationally. Strong language on potential costs and penalties. Regulation category critical for chemical products.

ai_positioning.summary: RPM does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K report. The information provided focuses on financial aspects, business segments and company operations, with no reference to AI or related technology.
